patent.title: Ceric oxide and method for production thereof, and catalyst for exhaust gas clarification
patent.family_note: Holdout INT-18. Sole EP(UK) in Anan/Rhodia v Neo. Prefer over any sibling ceria patents not adjudicated in that case. Expired Sep 2022.

knowledge_origin.description: Anan Kasei / Solvay-Rhodia exclusive licensee; inventorship Dai et al.; corporate RD assumed.

technology.problem: Produce high-surface-area ceric oxide suitable for exhaust-gas catalyst systems with thermal stability.
technology.mechanism: Ceric oxide (ceria) material / production method characterised for high specific surface area and catalyst use (court: HSA cerium oxide).

value_carriers.name: Rhodia HSA20 high-surface-area ceria (plaintiff) / Neo C100N (accused)
value_carriers.description: Court found Neo C100/C100N infringes; Rhodia HSA20 competed in UK/overseas catalyst powder market.

value_links.note: Liability + damages inquiry (UK head settled; overseas dismissed).

value_metrics.metric_name: settled UK Head 1 damages for infringement of EP(UK)1435338
value_metrics.note: UK head only. Do NOT use €24M overseas pleadings. Dispute-specific; not FMV.

gaps.description: E4 is a small UK-head settlement (face value of goods); overseas heads dismissed — teaches territoriality. Not a market license schedule or FMV.
No field-normalized quality score beyond infringement finding.

notes: Holdout INT-18. T0=2026-10-13. Court E3 + UK Head1 £85k E4 + E5 → R5. Pleadings/overseas ≠ E4. Judgment≠auto R5 without E3/exact_patent metric—those are present for UK head. Formal V0.7; not V0.8.
